name: Futari wa!?
source:
The protagonist, Yuusuke Ube is told by Takashi a classmate of the school he transferred to confess his love to Mayumi as a dare. Mayumi is the coolest and most beautiful girl in the school and confesses under the legendary tree. He is easily rejected.

However, as he was rejected, Sakura comforts him and things somehow become intimate.
However, she is rejected out of hand. Sakura comforts him, and somehow they become intimate.

Furthermore, as a result of getting to know Sakura, he was able to get to know Mayumi as well.  The two of them are close but there is something fishy about them...

The cool Mayumi and the fast-paced Sakura are swept away by each other, but they have an enjoyable school life.

However, the vice principal and the vice president of the student council seem to be plotting against each other. 

The two are going at their own pace, despite the unsettling atmosphere that is brewing in the school. What will Yuusuke do?

Will he play the role of a tsukkomi, or will he uncover a conspiracy? What will you do, Ube?

[From [url=http://www.complets.co.jp/authoringheaven/futariha.html]official site[/url]]
translation:
主人公宇部祐介被转学后的一位同学隆作为大冒险要求向真弓表白。真弓是学校里最酷最美的女孩，他在传说中的树下表白了。他轻易地被拒绝了。

然而，在被拒绝后，樱安慰了他，两人不知怎地变得亲密了。

此外，通过认识樱，他也得以认识了真弓。她们两人关系亲密，但总觉得有什么蹊跷……

冷酷的真弓和爽快的樱被彼此吸引，她们享受着愉快的校园生活。

然而，副校长和学生会副会长似乎在互相密谋什么。

两人按自己的节奏行事，尽管学校里酝酿着令人不安的气氛。祐介会怎么做？

他会扮演吐槽的角色，还是揭露阴谋？你会怎么做，宇部？

[引自[url=http://www.complets.co.jp/authoringheaven/futariha.html]官方网站[/url]]
